description.en-US: OpenBiliClaw is a local-first, open-source AI content discovery companion. Its Firefox sidebar connects to the OpenBiliClaw backend you run, collects only the supported browsing and interaction signals described in the privacy policy, and turns them into cross-source recommendations, an inspectable private profile, and feedback-driven tuning. Supported sources include Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, X, Zhihu, Reddit, Bangumi, V2EX, and Weibo. Weibo is backend-only discovery: the extension requests no Weibo host permission, reads no Weibo cookie, and runs no Weibo page task. The extension does not send data to servers operated by the OpenBiliClaw developers.
description.zh-CN: OpenBiliClaw 是本地优先、开源的 AI 内容发现伙伴。Firefox 侧边栏连接由你自行运行的 OpenBiliClaw 后端，仅采集隐私政策中说明的受支持浏览与互动信号，并生成跨来源推荐、可查看的私有画像和可持续反馈调教的推荐结果。支持 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube、X、知乎、Reddit、Bangumi、V2EX 与微博。微博仅由本地后端做公开 discovery：插件不申请微博 host permission、不读取微博 Cookie，也不执行微博页面任务。插件不会把数据发送到 OpenBiliClaw 开发者运营的服务器。

version.approval_notes: OpenBiliClaw is local-first and requires a user-run backend. It does not load remote code or send telemetry to servers operated by the project. The optional all-sites host permission is requested only when a user explicitly configures a non-local backend; public hosts require HTTPS and device authentication. The declared data categories cover supported-site browsing/activity signals, user-triggered search and source tasks, locally stored authentication status, and comments/chat/danmaku text only after the user successfully submits it. The *.v2ex.com permission is read-only: it collects Topic dwell metadata and, only when the user starts bootstrap or incremental sync, bounded rendered fields for the user's topics, public replies, favorite topics, and favorite Nodes. The extension checks only whether the A2 cookie exists and sends a login boolean; it does not access, store, or send the cookie value, page HTML, CSRF/once, private messages, or browser history, and it performs no V2EX write actions. Data is sent only to the backend endpoint configured by the user. A reproducible source archive is attached; from its root run `cd extension`, `npm ci`, then `npm run build:firefox` using Node.js 22. The output submitted for review is `extension/dist-firefox`. See docs/firefox-amo-source-build.md and docs/privacy.md for the complete build and data-flow explanation.

release_notes.en-US: Adds V2EX as an opt-in, strictly read-only source with anonymous discovery, optional PAT verification, four browser bootstrap scopes, account-isolated Node affinity, and text-card recommendations. It also hardens task recovery, snapshot retractions, identity mismatch handling, and privacy disclosures.
release_notes.zh-CN: 新增默认关闭、严格只读的 V2EX 来源：支持匿名发现、可选 PAT 验证、四类浏览器初始化、账号隔离的 Node 偏好与无封面文字卡；同时强化任务恢复、收藏快照撤回、身份冲突处理和隐私披露。
